ryan: Quick plan: tentative soft-unpin of runtime-2.17 in us-central at 04:00 UTC. We'll keep a tiny safelist (customers with sticky kvcache refs). Posting proposed safelist patch.

mira: Who owns SDK binding checks? We had a regression last time where tokenizers mismatched for SDK v3.4.

deploybot: [deploybot] pinlist preview: ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (2.16)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (2.17)
@@
-  - model: old-gptx
-    reason: longseq-kv-ref
+  # old-gptx remains pinned for legacy accounts
+  - model: alpaca-legacy
+    reason: reserved-for-dedicated
```

qa-bot: I'll run a 20m SDK v3.4 binding smoke at 03:15 UTC (tokenization, multi-turn, reconnect). Will post pass/fail.

sre-oncall: Rollback/abort thresholds: p50 >15% increase for 10m OR 5xx >2% sustained for 5m OR any OOM on runtime pods. If triggered, we'll run: `deploybot rollback --env us-central --runtime 2.16`.

ryan: Canary ramp: 0.5% for 15m, 2% for 30m, 10% for 30m. If QA smoke fails at any stage we hold.

mira: Approve after QA result. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: SDK smoke: PASS (no tokenization diffs, no fd leaks).

deploybot: [deploybot] change scheduled 04:00 UTC. React :thumbsup: to acknowledge.

ryan: Thanks. Monitoring window 3h post-lift. Ping thread for any customer-impacting issues.
